steps.name: branch name
steps.why: Conventional Branch: <type>/<description>. In CI it reads the PR's head branch, so --no-verify does not get past it. Bot branches pass.

steps.name: mermaid
steps.why: A broken mermaid diagram renders as an error box on GitHub and in chat. Setup: the writing-rules skill's Mermaid check.

steps.name: unit (changed)
steps.why: Only the tests the diff reaches, so the push stays inside the budget. A diff with a fullSuiteTriggers file runs the full suite: no test imports a lockfile or a test config. A repo adds its own paths, for example a migrations folder. The ci stage runs the full suite.

steps.name: unit
steps.why: The full suite holds the changed tests, so it replaces that step and each test runs one time.

steps.name: audit
steps.why: High and critical advisories only: lower levels fire on transitive dev dependencies and train everyone to ignore the check. Accept list: the verify skill's Audit section.

steps.name: e2e smoke
steps.why: A merge gate needs the critical paths, not the suite. Tag those specs @smoke; the rest runs nightly.

pr.$comment: The ci stage without the full suites. Only for a repo whose release PR runs ci and whose nightly runs: they are the net for what a PR leaves out. The Engine's plan.mjs picks the stage. A step with paths runs only when one of them changed.

nightly-scan.$comment: The checks that find new things without a code change. A night after no change runs only these (ADR-0004).

steps.name: deps drift
steps.why: Reports, never fails: npm outdated exits 1 whenever anything is behind, which is always.

steps.name: security scan
steps.why: Semgrep Community Edition ships on PyPI, not npm, so the runner needs python and pipx. --error turns findings into a non-zero exit. --exclude skips the skills and the Engine that skilly vendors: the consumer cannot fix them, sync overwrites them. --exclude keeps Semgrep's default ignore list, a .semgrepignore would replace it.

nightly.$comment: A night after a change on the default branch: the scan plus the full suites the pr stage leaves out.

steps.name: unit
steps.why: The pr stage runs only the tests a diff reaches. The full suite each night finds a main that broke with each PR green alone.
